summary: Second-pass verification of PATCH /api/me/password + coupling to accounting-unlock. All 7 new pytest cases pass, the 9/9 regression suite (test_accounting_unlock.py) still green, and full mobile E2E through /settings/password → logout → login-with-new-pw → tile-accounting → keypad unlock → /accounting succeeded. Password rotated back to pass123 at the end so downstream tests are unaffected.

issues: Non-blocking Expo web deprecation warnings in console: 'shadow*' style props deprecated → use boxShadow; props.pointerEvents deprecated → use style.pointerEvents; useNativeDriver missing RCTAnimation. Cosmetic only, no functional impact.

action_items: OPTIONAL: expose an in-app navigation path to /settings (currently no drawer/menu link references /settings). User currently has to reach password screen only via deep-link or from another entry point. Confirm this is intentional; if a drawer/menu exists elsewhere please expose it, otherwise ignore.
OPTIONAL: address console deprecations (shadow*→boxShadow, props.pointerEvents→style.pointerEvents) to silence Expo web warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: PATCH /me/password (server.py L634-660) correctly: (1) enforces new_password >= 6 chars with Arabic detail, (2) rejects wrong current with Arabic detail and 401, (3) rejects new==current with 400 Arabic, (4) hashes into the correct collection based on role (pharmacies/suppliers/admins), (5) returns {ok:true} on success.

Because /me/password and /auth/verify-password read from the same sha256 password column, the user's promise 'change once, unlock everywhere' is genuinely fulfilled — verified end-to-end from UI keypad after rotation.
Nit: /me/password uses sha256 (same as legacy auth). Not a regression but noting for future bcrypt migration.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_me_password.py (new — 7 tests: errors + happy rotate + rapid 3x + supplier cross-role + unauth)
seed_data_creation: No new seed data. Test also uses direct Mongo write to restore supplier seed pw `sup1` (4 chars, cannot be set via API's >=6 rule).
context_for_next_testing_agent: PATCH /api/me/password is now fully verified. Pharmacy seed 07700000001/pass123 and supplier seed 07811111111/sup1 are restored to their canonical values after the run. If a future test suite ever leaves pharmacy on `123456`, the fixture in test_me_password._reset_after_all handles rollback automatically. Note: /settings/password is reachable only by direct URL push in current build (no drawer link).
